The Beckhams have made an art of monetising their every move. But apparently there are limits to where they’re prepared to sell their wares

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).

items.title: Christina Ricci Claims Her 'Mermaids' Costar Cher 'Holds a Grudge' Against Her
items.summary:
Christina Ricci has opened up about the alleged breakdown of her friendship with Mermaids costar Cher .

“I’m not [still in touch]. Unfortunately, she’s still mad at me, she holds a grudge,” Ricci, 46, said on the Tuesday, November 17, episode of Watch What Happens Live With Andy Cohen when asked by the host about their friendship after bonding on the set of the 1990 film.

When Cohen, 58, expressed shock over Ricci’s response, the Yellowjackets star broke down her perspective on what went wrong with the pop icon, 80. Ricci said that during a joint magazine interview conducted when Ricci was 19 years old, Cher had said “all these things that were not that amazing about me.”

Her story continued, “Then she left me a voicemail about how journalists are always trying to get the worst things and blah, blah, blah, and she was so sorry, and I was 19, and so I didn’t return that message.”

Christina Ricci Reveals Which Iconic ‘90s Film She’d Love to Revisit 

Cohen, who pointed out that Ricci had spoken highly of her former costar previously on his show, then concluded, “She was mad at you for not returning the message,” to which Ricci agreed before further claimed that she’s reached out to the singer since and “gotten radio silence.”

Despite the claimed friction, Ricci said that she remains fond of Cher. “I adore her, she’s the best and I absolutely, 100 percent, can imagine being Cher and being like, ‘Oh my god, they misquoted me and I’m going to call this young person and explain to her that they misquoted me,’ and then the gall of that young person to not return the call,”…

Lifestyle influencer Emilie Kiser has shared her heartbreak as she prepares to mark one-and-a-half years since the death of her son, Trigg.

“Bawled the whole way home from my hair appointment, just missing my Triggy so so much,” Kiser, 27, wrote over a Tuesday, November 17, Instagram Story photo that showed her sitting in her car as tears streamed down her face. “I’m just so f***ing sad … tomorrow if a year and a half since we’ve lost Trigg and I just, literally, can’t even believe it.”

The social media personality, who announced in July that she is pregnant after the May 2025 death of Trigg, 3, following a fall into the family’s backyard pool, added that the reality of the milestone had hit her earlier in the week.

“It already has hit me, this entire week, but … it’s so painful, and just so s***ty,” she said.

Emilie Kiser Is ‘Really Struggling’ With Anniversary of Son Trigg’s Death 

A subsequent Instagram Story featured a photo of Kiser’s reddened face as she stared blankly ahead. “I genuinely hate making others uncomfortable, like, sometimes that’s how I feel crying in front of people or it being noticeable that I’ve been crying,” she wrote over the top of it. “So now avoiding going into my home because I have contractors here.”

An earlier Instagram Story had explained that despite the sunny disposition she often exhibits via her social media posts, “social media is fake sometimes.” She added that she wasn’t immune from “masking how I really feel” and explained that it’s how she survives “most days so my brain doesn’t completely shut down.”

During the Tuesday, November 17, episode of the hit CBS series, present-day Leroy Jethro Gibbs ( Mark Harmon ) passed out in his basement after his prior gunshot wound seemingly got infected.

While unconscious, Gibbs slipped in and out of a dream state — jumping from the ‘90s, where he spoke with Lala Dominguez ( Mariel Molino ), and to a full fantasy where he came face-to-face with a grown-up version of his former boss Mike Franks ( Muse Watson ), who died during season 8 of NCIS . (Watson played Franks on the flagship series on and off from 2006 to 2011 before his character’s death. He made cameos from seasons 9 to 15, which spanned from 2012 to 2017.)

'NCIS: Origins' Mariel Molino Breaks Silence on Gibbs and Lala's [Spoiler]

Schmid, 42, revealed that even without older Franks being alive in any universe, the character could continue to pop up — in another dream sequence or fever dream.

During the Tuesday, November 17, episode of ABC’s reality competition show, Ezra Frech , Maura Higgins , Connor Wood , Tatyana Ali , Harry Shum Jr. and Amber Glenn competed with their professional partners for a spot in the season 35 finale.

Each pairing had two full performances, with one ballroom and one Latin-inspired dance.

“Maura just exudes charisma,” Derek Hough shared at the top of the show. “Connor has been a huge surprise in this show.”

Ahead of Tuesday’s semifinals, Shum confirmed he and Johnson were using the Glee arrangement for inspiration. “It’ll be sung by the band, the wonderful Dancing With the Stars band. items.title: Patriots QB Drake Maye and Wife Ann Michael Maye's Relationship Timeline
items.summary:
Drake Maye was one of the first players picked in the 2024 NFL draft, and his then-girlfriend, Ann Michael Maye , was by his side when he joined the New England Patriots .

“Drake, words cannot describe how proud I am of you,” Ann Michael gushed via Instagram in April 2024. “What an incredible blessing it has been to be by your side through all of this ❤️ I love you and can’t wait for this next chapter!”

Drake, who previously was the quarterback for the University of North Carolina Tar Heels, was drafted by the Patriots in the first round. While making strides on the football field, Drake and Ann Michael got engaged in January 2025 before tying the knot that June.

The newlyweds had a wild first year of marriage , including Drake leading the Patriots to his first Super Bowl appearance with a win against the Denver Broncos in January 2026. Ann Michael was by her husband’s side every step of the way — including two snow-filled playoffs ahead of the February 2026 Super Bowl, which the team ultimately lost to the Seattle Seahawks.

Celeb Wives and Girlfriends of NFL Players Past and Present 

Keep scrolling for a look at Drake and Ann Michael’s sweet love story:

January 2020 
 Courtesy of Drake Maye/Instagram

items.title: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood
items.summary:
After years of celebrity interviews, I have learned not to be fooled by the allure of fame. We never really know them – we know what they want us to know

As I sat in Southwark crown court, listening to the final day of Russell Brand’s trial, there was one subject that came up repeatedly, invoked as often by his defence as the prosecution. I don’t mean sex or coercion, but fame. It ran through every victim impact statement and loomed so large in the courtroom that it felt as if it was almost on trial itself.

I’m an entertainment journalist who has been covering celebrities for more than 20 years – as long as Brand has been one – and I have written about him at various stages of his career. But I went to Southwark crown court as a member of the public who wanted to see justice done. For the women he had hurt, for the ones who couldn’t get as far as the courtroom, and for all of us who came of age at a time when rape culture was so fast and furious that young women mistook it for a joke that we were in on. In the age of lads’ mags, sex felt cheapened, yet somehow we were the ones who ended up paying for this. So it was doubly strange to sit in court and feel somehow complicit in it - in how this media culture had encouraged Russell Brand.

Continue reading...
items.t: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood

items.title: Two courtrooms, one celebrity: how did the Russell Brand case compare with the rape trial next door?

One was a high-profile defendant watched by more than 100 journalists. Another was an unknown man who preyed on a girl almost half his age. Their stories played out minutes apart, one entirely out of the spotlight

What is going on inside Russell Brand’s head as he arrives at court for the start of his rape trial? He sees the dozens of cameras and journalists lined outside Southwark crown court, many of whom have been waiting since before 7am, and he tells himself that the media are all against him. “It seems to me that they believe that I am guilty, and that this should be the rubber-stamping of the process of my destruction.”

He walks with his wife, Laura, and his bodyguard past the photographers, “clickering, clackering, snickering paparazzi, like locusts, peculiar concoctions, not fully humans”, and up into the court, where he is suddenly overwhelmed by “the presence of something very beautiful, grace”. “In a situation like I’m in, it’s impossible not to turn to God. Truth and justice are the only things that can save me,” he thinks.
